sentences.text: Case was heard on 30.11.2022,
Court has passed the following order:-
"Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Mrs. Ruchita Singh, learned counsel for O.P. No. 2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed praying for quashing of entire proceedings of the Case No.0116 of 2015 (State of U.P. Vs. Gaurav Chaturvedi And Others) arising out of the Case Crime No.1216 of 2014, under Sections 494, 498A,
323, 506 I.P.C., P.S.- Kuthond, District- Jalaun, pending before the learned Judicial Magistate, Jalaun, District- Jalaun on the basis of the Compromise.

entities.text: Case No.0116 of 2015 (State of U.P. Vs. Gaurav Chaturvedi And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that by the efflux of time the parties have reconciled their differences and a compromise has been entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the correctness of the compromise.

Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below along with a certified copy of this order on the next date fixed and be permitted to file an application for verification of the original compromise document.

It is expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order with respect to the verification within a period of two months from today.
Upon due verification, the court below may pass appropriate order in that regard and send a report to this Court.
List after two months.

Until further orders of the court, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants. "
4.

Pursuant to the order of this Court dated 30.11.2022, learned Judicial Magistrate, Jalaun has verified the compromise between the parties on 21.12.2022 and information to this effect has been received before this Court on 22.12.2022.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the present matter is arising out of matrimonial dispute and now the parties have entered into compromise, therefore, present proceeding may be quashed.

6. Sri Akshay Raj Singh, advocate holding brief of Ms. Richita Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has not objected the aforesaid fact and submitted that in case proceedings is quashed, he would have no objection.

sentences.text: 2 7. In view of above, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
The matter has been mutually settled between the parties, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.

8. Thus in view of the well settled principle of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the matters of Krishnappa & Ors. vs. State of Karnataka; 2021 0 Supreme(SC) 529, Parbatbhai Aahir @
Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and Ors. vs. State of Gujarat and another; 2017 9 SCC 641, B.S.
Joshi Vs. State of Haryana; 2003(4) SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Burea of Investigation and another; (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 677, Gian Singh Vs. Stated of Punjab; (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & others Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2014) Supreme Today 642, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
